summary.text: Johnnie Jones is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 83, running against incumbent Republican Grant Campbell in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has worked in the automotive industry, construction and filmmaking.

paragraphs.text: Johnnie Jones described himself in his Ballotpedia survey as a husband, a blue-collar working man and a neighbor who has worked with his hands and in long hours.
His three key messages were rising costs for households, properly funded public schools with competitive teacher pay, and expanded health care access including Medicaid expansion.
He also said he has a personal interest in policy on hyperscale AI data centers, and favors restrictions and expanded environmental review for them.
